title: Imagery and layers of meaning
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:48Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point, eng-imagery, covers how sense details place a reader in a scene but never teaches that one image can hold several meanings at once, and it is written for Year 11 rather than Year 7.

draft.title: Imagery and layers of meaning
card: Imagery is language that appeals to the senses: sight, sound, smell, taste and touch. It helps readers picture a scene as if they were in it.
Example: The kitchen smelled of burnt toast, and the cold tiles stung her bare feet. This uses smell and touch.
A single image can hold more than one meaning at once. A locked gate might be a real gate and also suggest a person who keeps others out.
To find a layer of meaning, ask what else the image could suggest about a character, a feeling or an idea.
draft.remember: Imagery paints a picture through the senses, and one image can mean more than one thing.

a.q: Which sentence uses imagery of sound?
opts: The rain drummed on the tin roof all night
The rain was cold and grey over the hills
The rain made the whole town feel sad
The rain fell on the town for three days
a.why: Drummed on the tin roof lets the reader hear the rain. The second option appeals to sight and touch. The third names a feeling and the fourth only states a fact.
a.clue: Which sentence lets you hear something?

b.q: A story describes a single candle left burning in a dark window for a missing son. What is a layer of meaning in this image?
opts: The candle suggests hope that he will return
The candle shows the family ran out of power
The candle proves the story is set in winter
The candle is there only to describe the room
b.why: The candle is a real light, and it also suggests hope. That is a second layer of meaning. The other options add details the image does not support or ignore its extra meaning.
b.clue: Ask what the light might suggest about the family's feelings.

a.best: The rain drummed on the tin roof all night

b.best: The candle suggests hope that he will return
